meta.title: Social trust
meta.question: Can most people be trusted?
meta.measure: Average trust in other people, from 0 (you can't be too careful) to 10 (most people can be trusted)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on trust or confidence in other people: whether most people can be trusted, try to be fair and try to be helpful, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Generally speaking, would you say most people can be trusted, or that you can't be too careful? (binary)
Can most people be trusted, or can you never be too careful? (can trust / can't be too careful / it depends)
items.notes: PGSS 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1997, 1999, 2002 (7 surveys). 'Inne odpowiedzi, to zależy' (volunteered) placed at 5. A random half of the sample in 1999 and 2002 (split ballot).

items.wording: Generally speaking, would you say most people can be trusted, or that you need to be very careful? (binary)
items.notes: WVS Poland 1989, 1997, 2005, 2012 (4 surveys). The 1989 wave predates the trend's start.

items.wording: Can people be trusted? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: POLPAN 1998 (XN05, in the 'AS' section), 1 wave.

items.wording: Would most people try to take advantage of you, or try to be fair? (almost always take advantage ... almost always fair), ISSP wording
items.notes: PGSS ISSP modules: re110 1999 (about a third of the sample) and ct10 2005 (2 surveys).

items.wording: Can people be trusted? (almost always can be trusted ... almost always need to be careful), ISSP wording
items.notes: PGSS ISSP modules: re7 1999 (random half) and 2010, ct11 2005, ls14a 2008 (4 surveys). Same four-point ISSP question under three names.

items.wording: Trust in most ordinary people (trust very much ... completely distrust)
items.notes: PGSW 2001 and 2005. 'Most ordinary people' in the PGSW trust battery, not the standard can-be-trusted question.

items.wording: If one is not on one's guard, others will take advantage (strongly agree ... strongly disagree)
items.notes: CBOS 2002-03, 2010-10, 2010-11, 2015-08, 2015-09 (5 surveys). Agreeing (distrust) is 0; midpoint 'i zgadzam się, i nie zgadzam się'.

items.wording: Most people would try to take advantage of you, or try to be fair (0-10)
items.notes: ESS Poland, rounds 1-11 (2002-2023), 11 surveys. Round 10 (2021-22) was self-completion; the pipeline's MODE_SPLITS makes it a question of its own.

items.wording: Most of the time people try to be helpful, or mostly look out for themselves (0-10)
items.notes: ESS Poland, rounds 1-11 (2002-2023), 11 surveys. Round 10 (2021-22) was self-completion; the pipeline's MODE_SPLITS makes it a question of its own.

items.wording: Most people can be trusted, or you can't be too careful in dealing with people (0-10)
items.notes: ESS Poland, rounds 1-11 (2002-2023), 11 surveys. Round 10 (2021-22) was self-completion; the pipeline's MODE_SPLITS makes it a question of its own.

items.wording: Most people would try to take advantage of you, or try to be fair (1-10)
items.notes: WVS Poland 2005 and 2012 (2 surveys).

items.wording: Generally speaking, most people can be trusted, or one has to be very careful in dealing with others (binary)
items.notes: CBOS 2006-01 (APiW 188), 1 survey.

items.wording: Most people in this society are trustworthy (completely agree ... completely disagree)
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes spring 2007, 1 survey (Polish N about 500).

items.wording: If you are not careful, other people will take advantage of you (strongly agree ... strongly disagree)
items.notes: PGSS 2008 ISSP Role of Government module, 1 survey. Agreeing (distrust) is 0.

items.wording: Most people are trustworthy (strongly disagree ... strongly agree)
items.notes: PGSS 2008, 1 survey (Yamagishi general-trust battery). The midpoint (code 4) is labelled 'nie mam zdania' and is placed at 5. The battery's other items (g5a, d, e, f, h, k) are left out as redundant.

items.wording: Can most people be trusted, or can't you be too careful? (can be trusted / can't be too careful / it depends)
items.notes: POLPAN 2008 (VG05), 1 wave. Code 8 'it depends, other responses' placed at 5, as in PGSS_PPLTRST_3.

items.wording: Can most people be trusted, or does one have to be very careful in dealing with people? (1 very careful ... 11 most can be trusted)
items.notes: CBOS 2008-07 (APiW 218), 1 survey; the ESS question on an 11-point card.

items.wording: Most people would try to take advantage of you, or try to be fair (1-10)
items.notes: EVS 2008, 1 survey. 1999's Swedish-only version (v66_se) is not matched.

items.wording: Most of the time people try to be helpful, or mostly look out for themselves (1-10)
items.notes: EVS 2008, 1 survey.

items.wording: Most people can be trusted, or you can't be too careful (1-10)
items.notes: Eurobarometer 72.1 (ZA4975, August-September 2009), 1 survey. Do not also use its recode (REC).

items.wording: Most people would try to take advantage of you, or try to be fair (0-10)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Most of the time people try to be helpful, or mostly look out for themselves (0-10)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Most people can be trusted, or you can't be too careful in dealing with people (0-10)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.
